message.content:
{"diagnosis": "Fetch TB reports TRAP: no progress max_addr=0x00000000 vs expected sequential NOP fetch progress beyond 0x0. mem_done at picorv32.v:376-377 is stuck-high because `resetn && (...) || (!mem_la_firstword || ...)` is true whenever !mem_la_firstword, so it asserts without mem_xfer/mem_state. Root cause is `||` instead of `&&` gating the compressed-firstword completion term, letting fetch retire without data and never advance PC.",
"patch_diff": "diff --git a/picorv32.v b/picorv32.v
--- a/picorv32.v
+++ b/picorv32.v
@@ -375,3 +375,3 @@
 	wire mem_busy = |{mem_do_prefetch, mem_do_rinst, mem_do_rdata, mem_do_wdata};
-	wire mem_done = resetn && ((mem_xfer && |mem_state && (mem_do_rinst || mem_do_rdata || mem_do_wdata)) || (&mem_state && mem_do_rinst)) ||
+	wire mem_done = resetn && ((mem_xfer && |mem_state && (mem_do_rinst || mem_do_rdata || mem_do_wdata)) || (&mem_state && mem_do_rinst)) &&
 			(!mem_la_firstword || (~&mem_rdata_latched[1:0] && mem_xfer));
",
"expected": "tohost PASS with fetch progress max_addr>0x00000000, no TRAP: no progress"}
